content.title: Event Object Relay | Tactile Chapters Rise into a Large Spectacle
content.summary: Lock one original clearly adult vlog subject with stable face, handheld distance and route direction. Build at least four event chapters, and require one acquired, used or carried object from each chapter to motivate the next: a food or token proves arrival, a game action earns a prize, the prize or gaze leads to a larger environmental spectacle, and the subject carries a visible residue into farewell. Escalate scale from hand to stall to crowd or sky, then return to the same selfie relation.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original vlog subject, stable handheld distance and one route direction. + Use at least four chapters and let one acquired, used or carried object motivate each transition. + Show one action-result pair for any game, purchase or exchange. + Escalate visual scale from hand to stall or activity to a larger environmental event. + Return to the same selfie relation with at least one accumulated object or residue for farewell.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open at an original night science fair on one clearly adult host with amber ear cuff, navy coat and fixed front-facing phone distance moving along a single lantern route. At the booth, show the adult placing three magnetic tiles into one complete pattern. The visible result releases a small triangular prism token into the same hand. Return to identical selfie distance. The same adult holds the prism token beside the amber ear cuff, gives one restrained farewell and lowers the phone; no source festival, food, ring toss, plush or fireworks.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult vlog subject with stable face, handheld distance and route direction. Build at least four event chapters, and require one acquired, used or carried object from each chapter to motivate the next: a food or token proves arrival, a game action earns a prize, the prize or gaze leads to a larger environmental spectacle, and the subject carries a visible residue into farewell. Escalate scale from hand to stall to crowd or sky, then return to the same selfie relation. The reusable mechanism is object-motivated chapter relay, action-result proof, scale ascent and same-subject farewell—not the source woman, clothing, festival, food, ring toss, plush, fireworks, locations, creator identity or timing.
